_about: Poll engine settings (scripts/poll_*.py). League-specific values live here, not in code. Times are local to `timezone`.

Final.label: Final Poll
Final._note: Same bots as the Top 25. Postseason games that needed a lineup (CCG, Playoff, Bowl, every NIT round) are extra games for Scoreboard (win %), Bracketologist (+ real opponents' regular-season all-play) and Monday Morning QB; Vegas, Bandwagon, Headliner, Bagman and Professor stay at week 11. NIT group = one game, result = share of rivals outscored. Bumps are added to Score per win (standard deviations): playoff by round R1..Final, CCG/Bowl flat, NIT x share. One regular-season win is worth about +0.13 (max +0.165), so every CCG/Bowl/playoff win counts more; NIT is a deliberate exception (weak field, up to 5 games). final_four_rule: a semifinal/final winner is raised directly above the team it beat (backstop; never fired 2024-2025). Decided 2026-10-07.

_points: 'linear' = size, size-1, ... 1 for ranks 1..size. Or an explicit list, e.g. [25,24,23,...].
_tiebreak: Score (BCS), then trimmed average bot rank, then the Standings bot. Teams still exactly tied share a rank.

ballots._commit_raw: Repo and site are public; ballots have never been public. Keep false: the Sheet is the record of ballots, only aggregates are committed.
ballots._outlier_spots: Private flag when a voter ranks a team this many spots above/below consensus (unranked counts as size+1).

intake._source_env: Secret: the Google Sheet response tab 'Publish to web' CSV link. Local files can also be passed with --file.

publish._post_to_league: false = the league post goes to lm-private-data as a preview only. Flip to true when ready.

bots.name: Scoreboard
bots.blurb: Exactly the playoff rank: wins, then points for
bots.voice: I only care about the standings.
bots.how: Wins (ties = half), then total points for as the tiebreaker. Weeks 1-11 only.

bots.name: Vegas
bots.blurb: Expected wins vs. every other team, every week
bots.voice: Strip out the schedule luck and tell me who is actually good.
bots.how: Each week, the share of all 180 teams you outscored. Summed over the season; points for breaks ties.

bots.name: Bandwagon
bots.blurb: All-play over the last 3 weeks, weighted 3:2:1
bots.how: All-play share over the last 3 weeks, weighted 3:2:1 (most recent heaviest).

bots.name: Bracketologist
bots.voice: Who you beat matters as much as how many.
bots.how: 60% win % + 40% average all-play strength of the opponents you played. Weeks 1-11 only.

bots.name: Headliner
bots.voice: Star power: the most points this roster could have put up.
bots.how: Average points per week of your best possible lineup from your own roster.

bots.name: Monday Morning QB
bots.how: Points scored / best possible lineup points, season to date.

bots.name: Bagman
bots.blurb: Redraft market value of the best starting lineup (FantasyCalc)
bots.voice: Follows the money: what the market says your starters are worth.
bots.how: FantasyCalc redraft value of your best legal starting lineup, from the latest value snapshot.

bots.name: Professor
bots.blurb: Starts with preseason roster strength, rewards quality weeks midseason, finishes on the resume
bots.voice: Grades on a curve that shifts as the semester goes on.
bots.how: Three blocks, each built from percentile ranks across all 180 teams; the block weights shift with games played (table below).

_bots: Each bot ranks every team. Turn one off with enabled=false; ids map to functions in scripts/poll_bots.py (also available: points, median, elo). Lineup chosen by backtest 2026-10-07 (claude/poll-backtest-2026-10-07.md).

consensus._note: Per team: each bot's value is standardized across the pool (z-score, clipped at +/-3), the best and worst bot are dropped, the rest averaged = Score (0 = average team; +1 = one standard deviation better). Chosen 2026-10-07: ties average rank in the backtest (seeds 0.958/0.927 vs 0.955/0.925) and gives the final poll's bumps a fixed meaning. Other methods: 'avg_rank' (average of best/worst-dropped ranks), 'points' (classic BCS top-25 points). ORV = outside the poll but in the top `size` of at least one counted bot.

human_component._note: When true, panel ballots (Google Form) become a second BCS component: HumanPct = ballot points / max. Score = mean of ComputerPct and HumanPct. The poll then waits for the ballot deadline; while false it publishes in the Tuesday weekly run.

seeding._note: Week 12 (CCG) points count for the Seeding poll bots only if true. Backtest compares both.

professor._note: All measures are percentile ranks across every team (all 180). Prior is frozen before week 1 (data/PollPrior_Season.csv, scripts/poll_prior.py). Block weights interpolate linearly between anchor weeks (games played).
